summary: Native Android release 0.5.11 (versionCode 13): a version bump only, so the manual mobile-release.yml lane can publish the Android fixes merged since mobile-v0.5.10 (2026-09-03), among them the synthetic-row and live task notices, readable Switchboard tool rows, the reattach status fix, runtime mode and profile sync, and phone approval of agent pull request cards.

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; no desktop code changes.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client ships over its own OTA lane; this bump touches only apps/android.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump; the features it ships carry their own manifests.

automated: mobile-release.yml runs the Android unit and lint gate and verifies package, monotonic version, signer fingerprint and checksum before it publishes.
notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
